messages:
erin: Quick FYI — I found a broken image + a redirect chain in the deploy runbook that folks hit during yesterday's incident. Link: https://redwood.internal/kb/deploy-troubleshooting (staging preview 404, image points to /assets/diag-old.png which 301s to external CDN then 404). Can someone grab a quick patch? Not urgent but a small annoyance for oncall. cc @matt @priya

matt: I can take it. Quick question — is the correct image already in the repo or do we need to reupload?

erin: looks like there is diag-v2.png under /assets/diagrams/, so likely just a path update. There's also a shortlink snippet that resolves out to an external doc that now redirects — probably safer to replace with the canonical internal path.

priya: thanks. If it's just replace and a small PR I'm free to review. tag me when PR is up. :+1:

matt: will open PR in a few mins. patch will: update image path, replace shortlink, add tiny frontmatter note about canonical URL. command I ran locally: 
```bash
sed -i 's#/assets/diag-old.png#/assets/diagrams/diag-v2.png#g' docs/deploy-runbook/deploy-troubleshooting.md
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: fix deploy runbook image path and canonical link"
```

docs-bot: docs-scan: detected redirect chain on https://redwood.internal/kb/short/xyz -> https://external.example.com/... flagged for manual review

sam: FYI from platform — if the image was served from legacy CDN we should rehost under docs-cdn to avoid future 301s. matt, can you add rehosting notes to the PR description if you reupload?

matt: yep. I'll rehost under docs-cdn/assets/diagrams/ and update path to /assets/diagrams/diag-v2.png. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (draft). Please review @priya @erin

erin: awesome, thanks! after merge can someone run the staging preview again? I can validate the preview link. :raised_hands:

priya: will review in next 30m. if all good I'll merge and ping ops to rebuild preview.

matt: PR updated with rehost notes and screenshot. ETA merge ~1h.

docs-bot: docs-bot: deploy-preview triggered for PR #412 — preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/pr/412 :eyes:

erin: verified preview — image loads, no redirect. closing the loop. thanks all.
